name: Orekore!
source:
My name is Miyashiro Kentarou. Second-year.

Classes have ended for today and I'm sitting here in the classroom - being disappointed in myself.

The results of the national mock exam just came back and the school which I wanted to attend in the future had graded me with a D... I can't help but feel dejected about that.´

I need a change of pace, so I watch "Ore no Collection" (short: Orekore).
It is an Ero-cosplay DVD which I bought. I even had to wear a disguise to get it.

...But as I finally return home, the DVD is nowhere to be found!
My childhood friend, Tachibana Misa, seems to have stashed it away.

I can retrieve the DVD if I were to pass a test that Misa has given me.
So I thrust my fist in the air!

"I will absolutely get Orekore back! And if everything goes well, then I'll also get into the university I want!"

But on the same day, a beautiful girl called Tsuruno Akiko moves in next-door. 
And faced with her supple, gorgeous body my ambitions to study are immediately blown away.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.inspire-doujin.com/study2/study2_index.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
我的名字是宫代健太郎。第二年。

今天的课程已经结束，我坐在教室里——对自己感到失望。

全国模拟考试的成绩刚刚出来，我以后想就读的学校给了我D的成绩……我不禁感到沮丧。

我需要改变节奏，所以我看了“Ore no Collection”（简称：Orekore）。
这是我买的色情角色扮演DVD。我什至必须乔装打扮才能得到它。

…但是当我终于回到家时，却找不到DVD了！
我的青梅竹马橘美沙似乎把它藏起来了。

如果我通过了Misa给我的测试，我就可以取回DVD。
于是我把拳头举向空中！

“我一定会把Orekore找回来！如果一切顺利的话，我也会考上我想要的大学的！”

但就在同一天，一位名叫鹤野晶子的美丽女孩搬进了隔壁。
面对她那柔嫩、美丽的身体，我的学习雄心顿时被打消了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.inspire-doujin.com/study2/study2_index.html]官网[/url]]
